youtube.title: Mittens' Kitchen Shapes! (SWISH!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🐱 SWISH! Mittens the cat swished her tail and all the shapes fell off the kitchen shelf! Can you help Mittens find them?

Learn 7 shapes with Mittens: circle, square, rectangle, triangle, oval, hexagon and star! Each shape comes back one by one, and Mittens shows where you can spot it, like a round plate, a door and an egg. Then sing the kitchen shapes song with Mittens, and stay till the end, because something yummy is waiting on the table! 🍪

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn 7 shapes: circle, square, rectangle, triangle, oval, hexagon and star
✔️ Count the sides: a triangle has 3, a square has 4, a hexagon has 6
✔️ Spot shapes in everyday things: plates, doors and eggs
✔️ Sing a happy shapes song with Mittens!
